title: Pi has no Mode (user 2026-11-19: "pi should not have a \"mode\""). A New Agent Chat on Pi, whose ACP bridge mirrors its thinking levels as modes, draws the model chip with no Mode chip; a New Agent Chat on Claude Code keeps its Mode chip. A Pi chat that ran, and a fresh New Agent Chat on Pi after it, draw no Mode chip either. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/pi-has-no-mode.json --mac

pi.description: Synthetic capture harness: a stand-in for Pi's ACP bridge (pi-acp 0.0.33) that answers session/new as it does, its thinking levels as the thought_level option and mirrored as modes; inline so the before commit runs it too

steps.title: Launch
A fixed window size, so every capture frames the composer the same
A workspace for the Claude chat
Show Claude
Open a New Agent Chat tab for Claude
A New Agent Chat on Claude, before any send
Wait for the Claude composer
Claude: the composer's chips (Pi: model and thinking, no Mode; Claude Code: its Mode)
A workspace for the Pi chat
Show Pi
Open a New Agent Chat tab for Pi
A New Agent Chat on Pi, before any send
Wait for the Pi composer
Pi: the composer's chips (Pi: model and thinking, no Mode; Claude Code: its Mode)
Pi answers one prompt, as a person's earlier Pi chat did (its session reports options and copied modes)
Trust /tmp for the chat (the folder question its first send asks)
Pi's running chat: model and thinking, no Mode
A second workspace for a fresh Pi New Agent Chat
Show Pi2
Open a New Agent Chat tab for Pi again
A fresh New Agent Chat on Pi, before any send
Fresh Pi New Agent Chat: no held Mode chip
